Semester subtotals (18/17/6/15) + prerequisites (5) reconcile to Program Total 61. 'Elective - General Education Course' is the catalog's own slot label (links to the General Education Course requirements page); HLF-Elective uses the catalog slot label. Per-course prerequisites are not published on the program page; prereq lists are empty. ABAC plans); collector had recorded 61 including the prerequisite phase. The catalog's printed program total and the prerequisite phase remain documented above.]
